metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API - SOC 2 GRC baseline

components.title: acme-health-intake-grc-baseline
components.description: The Acme Health Patient Intake API (forked from GRCEngClub/cgep-app-starter) plus the GRC baseline wrapped around it: a customer-managed KMS key, an Object Lock evidence vault, a multi-region CloudTrail, and Terraform overrides closing GAP-01, GAP-02, GAP-03, GAP-04, GAP-05, and GAP-07 from the starter's GAPS.md.
components.purpose: Make the starter's PHI-handling intake workload audit-defensible against SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria without slowing down the engineering team.

control-implementations.description: SOC 2 Type II is this component's declared primary framework (see WRITEUP.md). AICPA publishes no official OSCAL catalog for the Trust Services Criteria, so per the starter's FRAMEWORKS.md guidance, each SOC 2 criterion below is mapped to its closest NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control and that catalog is cited as source. Every implemented-requirement's description names the SOC 2 CC ID first so it reads as the same control the corresponding Rego policy in policies/ cites.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 CC6.1 (logical access controls -- restrict access to information assets). Closes GAP-01: the uploads bucket's AWS-managed SSE-S3 default is replaced with SSE-KMS under a customer-managed key, so PHI keys are under customer custody, not AWS's.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 CC6.1 (logical access controls -- restrict access to information assets). Closes GAP-02: the submissions table's AWS-owned default key is replaced with the same customer-managed CMK used by the uploads bucket.

links.text: TODO (Week 4): replace with the real vault bucket/run ID/SHA. Bundle's plan.json will show the table's server_side_encryption block with kms_key_arn resolving to aws_kms_key.grc.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 CC6.7 (transmission security -- protect data in transit). Closes GAP-03: the uploads bucket now carries a bucket policy denying any request where aws:SecureTransport is false.

links.text: TODO (Week 4): replace with the real vault bucket/run ID/SHA. Conftest output for compliance.soc2.cc6_7_s3_tls_only in the bundle confirms the Deny/SecureTransport statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 A1.2 (system availability -- backup, recovery). Closes GAP-04: versioning is enabled on the uploads bucket, so an overwritten or deleted PHI object is recoverable.

links.text: TODO (Week 4): replace with the real vault bucket/run ID/SHA. Bundle's plan.json shows versioning_configuration.status = "Enabled".

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 CC6.6 (boundary protection -- protect from unauthorized access to internal information). Closes GAP-05: the intake Lambda now runs inside the starter's private subnets instead of the default (boundary-less) Lambda environment, reachable via dedicated gateway VPC endpoints rather than the public internet.

links.text: TODO (Week 4): replace with the real vault bucket/run ID/SHA. Conftest output for compliance.soc2.cc6_6_lambda_vpc confirms the vpc_config block.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 CC6.3 (authorization -- least privilege, periodic access reviews). Closes GAP-07: the Lambda's inline role policy no longer grants dynamodb:*/s3:*; it is scoped to exactly the actions terraform/lambda/handler.py performs (dynamodb:PutItem, s3:PutObject) plus the KMS actions needed to write through the CMK.

links.text: TODO (Week 4): replace with the real vault bucket/run ID/SHA. Conftest output for compliance.soc2.cc6_3_iam_least_privilege confirms no wildcard actions remain.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements SOC 2 CC7.2 (system monitoring -- detection of anomalies, security events), partially. GAP-06: reserved_concurrent_executions caps runaway Lambda scaling; a dead-letter queue was deliberately not added because the Lambda's only trigger is the synchronous API Gateway proxy integration, and DLQs only capture failed *asynchronous* invocations. X-Ray tracing is not yet implemented. GAP-08: the API Gateway stage now has access logging and throttling; a WAF is not yet implemented. See WRITEUP.md, "what you didn't get to."
